sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report is filed regarding unauthorized card transactions on account of customer C11923. Between 2016-12-29 and 2016-12-29, primary card C11923-K2 exhibited 1 suspicious transaction(s) totaling $67.91 USD conducted via the online channel. The flagged activity aligns with the typology of card testing. The transaction pattern exhibited repeated low-value online authorizations under $5 followed by larger purchase attempts, indicative of automated card verification. Identified device profile (SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | Unknown | chrome 66.0 for android | Unknown) was observed linking across multiple customer cards, indicating syndicated or coordinated fraud operation. Coordinated activity directly connects to additional compromised card identifiers: C05678-K1, C05595-K1, C03938-K1. Investigative follow-up: Customer states they did not make this transaction, remains in possession of the card, and requests card protection. Total exposure of confirmed fraudulent transactions is quantified at $67.91 USD. In accordance with institutional security policy and BSA/AML requirements, the affected card has been blocked and designated for reissue. Connected accounts have been placed under heightened surveillance to mitigate further financial exposure.
